additionalVarieties.name: Gerard
additionalVarieties.text: A French variety with red skin and fine flavour. The tubers are rounder than Fuseau; check availability with specialist suppliers.
additionalVarieties.sourceText: A red-skinned variety with fine flavour. Plant in spring and lift from autumn onwards. As with all Jerusalem artichokes, dig carefully and remove all tubers if the bed is to be cleared.

scope: Append one fourth variety and arrange the four in two rows of two. Preserve every existing word, fact, artwork, heading, style and the whole practical page. No canonical edit.
